messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — AZ az1a egress proxy errors impacting inference pool. p95 latency spike + 5xx increase. TAG: @alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): I'm on it. joining zoom, collecting quick metrics.

alice (oncall): running quick healthcheck against proxy cluster
```
curl -s -D - http://proxy-az1a.health.local/health | head -n 10
```

alice (oncall): proxies return 200 but upstream grpc to inference nodes shows timeouts and ECONNRESET in logs.

ben: I see resolver logs with repeated NXDOMAIN/timeouts around the same window. Could be resolver overload in az1a.

charlie-sre: can we shift egress to az1b/az2? Traffic policy allows cross-AZ fallback, but we need to adjust sticky routing and KV cache considerations.

alice (oncall): initiating traffic-shift plan: enable fallback routing + lower sticky affinity for 2m. Applying now.

alice (oncall): runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/az-egress-proxy (see steps 3-5). also opening tracker: https://redwoodops.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026

support-rotations: Customer impact flags: several high-qps customers show 5-10% error spikes and elevated tail latency. No broad 100% outages. We're notifying top affected accounts.

alice (oncall): now toggled fallback policy. Observing gradual drop in 5xx and p95 improving from 1.8s -> 420ms for inference requests via fallback.

charlie-sre: good. we should also prewarm az1b KV-cache to avoid regen storms. kicking a warmup job to populate prefixes from cache snapshot.

ben: DNS resolver metrics still show elevated query latency. Ops asked AWS support to look at resolver endpoint for az1a, opened SR-78321.

alice (oncall): customer comm drafted for impacted customers; will ping support to send targeted note + mitigation steps.

sre-lead: handing off to night oncall @ben for follow-up and SR tracking. If anything regresses, escalate to infra-incident. Good work team :thumbsup:

ben: taking over. I have runbook/links and SR. Will monitor for 2h and coordinate with AWS if resolver doesn't stabilize.
